# Creek Freak Fantasy Football — Week 9 briefing
**Monday, November 2, 2026 | Tua in the pink | 12 teams | full PPR | two FLEX | head-to-head plus league median**

## Executive call
**Prioritize RB insurance, not another receiver.** Jonah Coleman has become a genuinely useful RB2 after a 20.4-point Week 8, but Jeremiyah Love aggravated his ankle and David Montgomery remains out. Gibbs (24.8) and McBride (20.2) are still your core. Your Week 9 opponent is the 9–5 team named "."; the trade deadline is Week 11.

**Actions in order:** (1) claim TreVeyon Henderson as a longer-term upside stash if his recovery outlook suits your roster; (2) target Dylan Sampson if you need immediately usable PPR RB depth; (3) shop Jamo plus a secondary WR for a proven RB; (4) remove Germie Bernard from Week 9 consideration because Pittsburgh is on bye. Do not drop Coleman, Love, Nico, Tet, or McBride.

## Week 8 live scoreboard — not yet final
You trail **Vicks Dogg Pound 115.56–121.76** (6.20 points). Monday night's Bears–Seahawks game is still to come; Vicks has Bears players Luther Burden III and Colston Loveland showing zero so far, and you have no remaining starters. The head-to-head result therefore looks very unlikely to flip, but Sleeper still marks the week in progress.

The **current league median is 107.95** (middle two scores 104.66 and 111.24). You are 7.61 points above it, so the median result currently projects to a win, **not yet a confirmed win**; Monday scoring can move the median. A likely Week 8 outcome is **1–1** (H2H loss, median win), pending final scores.

Your Week 8 starters: Gibbs **24.8**, Coleman **20.4**, McBride **20.2**, Keenan Allen **13.7**, Tet McMillan **11.8**, Bryce Young **11.36**, Germie Bernard **8.0**, Love **2.3**, Denver D/ST **2**, Spencer Shrader **1**. **Jameson Williams scored 17.0 on your bench**; replacing Love with Jamo would have added **14.7** points, although Love's in-game ankle reinjury was not knowable in advance. Caleb Douglas added 8.3 on the bench.

Other Week 8 current scores: Team DBURR6 **151.06** vs Hanging with Hernadez **104.66**; Master Bates **174.62** vs Step Burrow i'm Stuck **111.24**; 2 Girls 1 Kupp **157.68** vs Landry Kiffin **82.50**; 4th and inches **94.40** vs "." **65.30** (Monday players still pending); Amon my period **94.28** vs Team Mully92 **87.38**. ## Injuries and role changes that matter
- **Jeremiyah Love — HIGH PRIORITY:** He returned from two missed games, then hurt his ankle again against Dallas on Nov. 1 and was ruled out for the rest of the game. Do not pencil him into Week 9 against Seattle until fresh practice reports arrive. [NFL injury report](https://www.nfl.com/news/notable-injuries-news-sunday-week-8-games-2026); [follow-up](https://www.si.com/nfl/cardinals/onsi/injured-jeremiyah-love-ruled-out-arizona-cardinals-dallas-cowboys-week-8-battle).
- **Jonah Coleman — HOLD/START:** Denver's rookie delivered 11 carries, 41 rushing yards and a TD plus four catches for 63 yards vs KC, while RJ Harvey was out with a knee issue. Coleman had 15 touches to J.K. Dobbins' seven and faces Carolina in Week 9. This is more than a one-play fluke, though Harvey's return could alter the split. [Usage recap](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/players/28877250/jonah-coleman/fantasy/).
- **David Montgomery — WAIT:** His groin injury kept him out before Houston's Week 8 bye. No confirmed Week 9 return yet; check Houston's Wednesday/Friday practices. [Injury background](https://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/texans/article/david-montgomery-injury-woody-marks-fantasy-22472506.php).
- **Nico Collins and C.J. Stroud — BACK FROM BYE:** Houston visits the Chargers Week 9. Nico should return to your WR starting group if healthy; Stroud is again available after his bye. [Week 9 schedule](https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-9).
- **Germie Bernard — BYE:** Pittsburgh is off Week 9. His Week 8 five catches for 30 yards (8.0 PPR) are not a reason to start him over higher-upside receivers later; Pittman's potential Week 10 return could further squeeze his role. [Steelers stats](https://www.steelers.com/game-day/2026/week8/browns-at-steelers/); [Pittman status](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/players/2240188/michael-pittman/).
- **TreVeyon Henderson — HEALTH RISK:** New England ruled him out Week 8 due to illness, on top of a recent high-ankle-sprain absence. This is an upside stash, not a safe Week 9 starter. [Patriots update, Nov. 1](https://www.patriots.com/news/roster-analysis-patriots-downgrade-wr-a-j-brown-rb-treveyon-henderson-to-out-for-week-8-vs-dolphins).

## Waiver board — confirmed available in this Sleeper league
**STRONG / immediate team fit**
1. **Dylan Sampson, RB CLE:** Eight targets, six catches and 62 receiving yards against Pittsburgh; he ran routes on 29 of 49 Cleveland dropbacks. A practical PPR insurance policy if Love/Montgomery miss time, though he had just one carry. [Week 8 role](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/football/player-news/2026-11-01/sampson-has-six-catches-in-loss-to-steelers).
2. **TreVeyon Henderson, RB NE:** Unexpectedly dropped by Step Burrow i'm Stuck on Nov. 1. Higher longer-term ceiling than Sampson, but health and Rhamondre Stevenson's role make him a stash. Use priority 6 only if comfortable waiting. [Patriots status](https://www.patriots.com/news/roster-analysis-patriots-downgrade-wr-a-j-brown-rb-treveyon-henderson-to-out-for-week-8-vs-dolphins).

**UPSIDE / situational**
3. **Adonai Mitchell, WR NYJ:** Seven catches on nine targets, 142 yards and a TD in Week 8. Big breakout, but Garrett Wilson also drew 12 targets; don't mistake one week for a secure WR1 role. Your roster is already WR-heavy. [Recap](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/football/news/jets-adonai-mitchell-career-high-142-yards-in-week-8/).
4. **Kimani Vidal, RB LAC:** Eight carries, 23 yards, two catches for seven yards in Week 8; rotational, touchdown-dependent depth behind/alongside Omarion Hampton. Lower priority than Sampson. [Recap](https://staging-aws.sports.yahoo.com/articles/kimani-vidal-held-check-rams-031013742.html).
5. **Courtland Sutton / Cooper Kupp / Quentin Johnston, WR:** Available alternatives, but none is a mandatory add over Nico, Tet, Jamo, or Keenan. Sutton has had no more than five targets in four straight games. [Sutton usage](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/football/news/broncos-courtland-sutton-four-catches-in-week-8-victory/).

**Avoid traps:** Terry McLaurin and Jayden Reed appear on the available list but are **out for the season**, not useful 2026 stashes. [Washington](https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-terry-mclaurin-injured-reserve-jer-zhan-newton); [Green Bay](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/packers-placing-wr-jayden-reed-163101127.html).

**Drops/roster mechanics:** First possible cut is **Bryce Young** (one-week bye fill-in; Stroud returns). You already dropped Roschon Johnson Oct. 27. If claiming a second player, consider **Caleb Douglas** only if you prefer Mitchell's emerging target upside; do not casually cut Keenan, Jamo, or your injured RBs. Your two IR-eligible reserve slots show Jordyn Tyson in one; check whether an available injury stash is actually IR-eligible in Sleeper before making a move. Waiver status and claim processing can change after this snapshot.

- **Oct. 30:** **4th and inches claimed Mike Evans** and **Team Mully92 claimed Zach Charbonnet**. Both of your claims for those players failed; neither is currently an available waiver target.
- **Oct. 28:** Hanging with Hernadez added **Kyle Pitts** and **Jacoby Brissett**, dropping Pat Freiermuth and Charbonnet; 2 Girls 1 Kupp later added Freiermuth.
- **Nov. 1:** Team DBURR6 added **Keon Coleman**, dropping MarShawn Lloyd; Landry Kiffin added **Kenny Gainwell**, **Samaje Perine**, and **Kendrick Bourne** in a flurry of moves.
- No completed player-for-player trade appears in the returned Week 7–8 transaction window. The transaction window is limited to those two weeks; older moves are not covered.

## Trade calls — before the Week 11 deadline
**Target a reliable RB2 while retaining Gibbs, McBride, Nico and Tet if possible.**
1. **Team DBURR6 (8–6): Offer Jameson Williams + Caleb Douglas for Chase Brown.** Brown posted 16.1 in Week 8 and his manager has McCaffrey/Bucky Irving but starts thin WRs. This is a **negotiation opener**, not a guaranteed fair-market acceptance. If declined, don't automatically add Tet.
2. **Step Burrow i'm Stuck (2–12): Test Jameson Williams + Keenan Allen for Josh Jacobs.** Jacobs posted 23.2 in Week 8; the other roster has Derrick Henry and thin WRs. This may still be rejected, but it is a real roster-fit proposal.
3. **Landry Kiffin (7–7): Keenan Allen for injured DeVonta Smith** only as a secondary buy-low inquiry; your immediate need is RB, so do not divert a strong RB trade package toward Smith.

**Do not send both Jamo-based offers with the intention of accepting both.** Do not sell Coleman just because he scored 20.4: his rising workload is exactly what your team needs. Treat Jamo as your sell-high chip after 26.1 and 17.0 in consecutive weeks; the return must be a real RB upgrade.

## Early Week 9 lineup and watch list
**Opponent: "." (9–5 entering Week 8)**, with Jonathan Taylor, Quinshon Judkins, Drake London, Chris Olave, Emeka Egbuka and Tony Pollard on its current roster. The opponent's Week 8 score is incomplete because of Monday players.

**Early starters:** QB **C.J. Stroud**; RB **Gibbs, Coleman**; WR **Nico Collins, Tet McMillan**; TE **Trey McBride**; FLEX **Jameson Williams, Keenan Allen**; K **Spencer Shrader**; D/ST **Denver**. These are provisional, not injury-cleared Week 9 projections. **Sit Bernard (bye)**. If Montgomery practices fully and is cleared, reassess the second FLEX; if Love is cleared, don't assume he gets a normal workload after another ankle exit.

**Watch Wednesday–Friday:** Love's ankle imaging/practice; Montgomery's groin; RJ Harvey's knee and Coleman's snap share; Nico's health and Houston's post-bye offense; Henderson's return-to-practice; and whether Mitchell earns another high-target role. Denver plays Carolina; Detroit plays Miami; Houston visits the Chargers; Arizona visits Seattle. [Official Week 9 schedule](https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-9).
